title: What do you see?
text: The relationship is showing multiplication, in particular representing $$2$$ times $$3$$ as a group of $$6$$ blocks arranged in a grid.

title: Which relationship?
text: The grid is arranged with $$3$$ rows and $$2$$ columns on the left, and this is shown as equal to the $$6$$ blocks in a grib of $$2$$ rows and $$3$$ columns on the right.

title: Putting it together
text: This depicts the commutative relationship of mulitplication, the fact that $$ab=ba$$.
